newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian PM sees election in 15 to 18 months.
newsitem.headline: Australian PM sees election in 15 to 18 months.

text.p: Australian Prime Minister John Howard said on Wednesday an election would be held in 15 to 18 months.

Controversial politician Pauline Hanson, at the centre of a race row, would not take away sufficient conservative support to affect an election, he said. "I don't believe it will because the election is not for another 15 or 18 months," Howard told Australian Broadcasting Corp radio.
The election is due in early 1999 or maybe late 1998. An election earlier than that would depend on the upper house, the Senate, having obstructed government legislation.
